headline: Pepperdine and LMU finish level at the top
dek: LMU shares first place despite scoring thirteen goals in all its matches while conceding sixteen. Its goalkeeper, JJ Hoover, has recorded nine shutouts behind that defense.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Seattle U has scored more goals than LMU, Pacific and Portland together, yet it is LMU that shares first place: in this conference, goals have not ordered the table.

wire.line: Santa Clara has not lost to a conference side all season; all three of its defeats came against outside opponents.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Seattle U has won twelve matches, more than any other program in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: At least fourteen different players have scored for Santa Clara this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pacific has won once all season, against fifteen defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two August matches have no published result; Saint Mary's College of California and Santa Clara were the conference sides due to play them.

last_match.line: Santa Clara lost at home to the same opponent in September; no conference side has beaten Santa Clara this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
